reframing_moves.reframe: A commenter reframes this as: economic growth is real but unevenly distributed — 'this growth hasn't fallen evenly on every person'; the relevant question is not whether China is growing but whether you specifically are positioned to capture any of that growth
reframing_moves.why_it_works: Deflates the macro narrative by forcing personalization; prevents people from making location decisions based on aggregate GDP trends rather than their own specific opportunity set
reframing_moves.example_language: '国内经济发展确实好，但是这个好并不是均匀地落在每个人身上的'
reframing_moves._source: zhihu_如果你已经有了美国工作签_你会选择留美还是回国.txt

reframing_moves.original_framing: I should keep working hard at my current job — maybe I'm just not trying hard enough
reframing_moves.reframe: Ask not whether you're working hard enough but whether continuing this job serves your internal needs or only external ones — sustained misery while externally compliant is not a temporary problem to push through
reframing_moves.why_it_works: Breaks the 'effort will fix it' loop by distinguishing internal motivation from external compliance — reorients the question from 'how hard am I working' to 'why am I working'
reframing_moves.example_language: 如果工作的理由仅仅是为了满足外部需求而不是内心的冲动，那么这个人一生的大部分时间都会过得很痛苦
reframing_moves._source: zhihu_未来应留在美国还是回国生活.txt

reframing_moves.original_framing: Returning to China means accepting a lower quality of life — the US is just better to live in
reframing_moves.reframe: Quality of life is multi-dimensional. The US offers quiet and clean; China offers density, energy, food culture, and social richness. The question is which dimensions matter to you — not which country 'wins' overall.
reframing_moves.why_it_works: Disaggregates a composite judgment into separable dimensions, allowing the person to match country choice to personal preference rather than accepting a community consensus ranking
reframing_moves.example_language: '好脏好乱好快活' vs '好山好水好寂寞' — framing both options as having genuine upsides and genuine costs rather than one being objectively superior
reframing_moves._source: zhihu_海归女硕士一枚_快毕业了是继续留在美国还是回国工作.txt

reframing_moves.original_framing: I need to find a way to get into coding/tech to stay in the US and make the immigration math work
reframing_moves.reframe: The author implicitly reframes through the case samples: the CS/FAANG track is one path among many; people in journalism, law, environmental engineering, education, and media have also built stable, satisfying lives in the US — the immigration constraint is real but it does not collapse to 'become a coder or leave'
reframing_moves.why_it_works: Expands the solution space beyond the dominant community narrative; people who are unsuited for coding stop pursuing it as a forced solution and look for paths that fit their actual skills
reframing_moves.example_language: Sample 6 (lawyer), Sample 7 (environmental engineer), Sample 10 (media/BD) presented as equally valid successful outcomes alongside the CS cases
reframing_moves._source: zhihu_如果你已经有了美国工作签_你会选择留美还是回国.txt

reframing_moves.original_framing: I need to break the glass ceiling — I need to fight for a higher position
reframing_moves.reframe: Ask whether you actually want to be at the top of that hierarchy, or whether you just want to confirm the grass isn't greener — most people find that a solid floor matters more than breaking the ceiling
reframing_moves.why_it_works: Distinguishes genuine ambition from status anxiety and social comparison — most people, when honestly asked, want comfort and security more than power, and recognizing this makes the ceiling less psychologically threatening
reframing_moves.example_language: 与其说打破天花板，更让我们关心的其实是脚下的地板是不是足够厚实
reframing_moves._source: zhihu_未来应留在美国还是回国生活.txt

reframing_moves.original_framing: I have a work visa and things are stable — I should probably just stay
reframing_moves.reframe: Stable and satisfying are not the same thing. A 5-year view of your US career is already mostly visible. If that view doesn't excite you, stability is a trap, not an asset.
reframing_moves.why_it_works: Distinguishes between risk-avoidance (staying because leaving is scary) and genuine preference (staying because the future is appealing) — forces honest assessment of whether the stable path is actually wanted
reframing_moves.example_language: '看着办公室里的老人们一眼望到20、30年后的生活' (Looking at the office seniors and being able to see my life 20-30 years out in one glance)
reframing_moves._source: zhihu_海归女硕士一枚_快毕业了是继续留在美国还是回国工作.txt
